newsitem.title: USA: GNI Group combination talks terminated.
newsitem.headline: GNI Group combination talks terminated.

text.p: GNI Group Inc said on Friday that discussions about a possible business combination with an unnamed company have been terminated because the two companies were unable to reach an agreement after several months.
GNI released no further details about the discussions, except to say that "other opportunities came to light," and the company will "evaluate those opportunities to enhance shareholder value."
GNI makes specialty chemicals and manages hazardous and non-hazardous waste.
